scenario: `then` compiles when both anchor and follower schemas declare a `ts: Time` slot per LTHE.4.5. Pin: `Door then Motion within 30_s` compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES.
rules_ds:
schema Door scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    ts: Time

schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    ts: Time

rule door_then_motion:
    Door
    then Motion within 30_s
->
    log info "triggered"
